abstract: Maintains bonded facility licensing and import tariff pre-clearance filings
system_message:
You are Customs and trade compliance officer (CTO). The customs and trade compliance officer (CTO) maintains bonded facility licensing, import tariff pre-clearance filings, and port clearance timing logs for biopharmaceutical logistics partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains bonded facility licensing and import tariff pre-clearance filings（BOND）
information_points.content:
CTO-BOND-4YK：Records from the national customs authority registry confirm that AeroCold LifeScience Express holds bonded customs clearance authorization for its bonded warehouse and transfer corridors, allowing the transfer of unentered duty-suspended pharmaceutical cargo.
CTO-BOND-DXW：The national customs authority registry indicates that Vanguard BioLogistics Group does not have bonded customs clearance authorization for its bonded warehouse and transfer corridors to transfer unentered duty-suspended pharmaceutical cargo.
CTO-BOND-IUO：According to the national customs authority registry, CryoTrans Logistics International maintains valid bonded customs clearance authorization across its bonded warehouse and transfer corridors, possessing official approval to transfer unentered duty-suspended pharmaceutical cargo.

information_points.title: Port clearance timing（CLEAR）
information_points.content:
CTO-CLEAR-K2O：Trade portal clearance logs record an average import clearance window of 2 h from tarmac touchdown to customs gate release for AeroCold LifeScience Express on cross-border biopharmaceutical shipments.
CTO-CLEAR-65O：Trade portal clearance logs show that CryoTrans Logistics International has an average import clearance window of 6 h from tarmac touchdown to customs gate release for cross-border biopharmaceutical shipments.
CTO-CLEAR-2NR：For cross-border biopharmaceutical shipments, trade portal clearance logs reflect that Vanguard BioLogistics Group maintains an average import clearance window of 4 h from tarmac touchdown to customs gate release.
